quick-paws
A single tan feline paw in a battered small steel running boot, two bold teal speed streaks trailing left. Clear running silhouette.
extra-scrap
A generous compact pile of three salvage nuts and a bronze metal offcut, with one bold gold upward chevron behind it. Currency gain, not a magnet.
hot-barrel
A short gun barrel with a vivid orange hot muzzle and three compact orange firing streaks. Faster fire, no whole gun and no literal flame damage.
scrap-magnet
A large rust-red horseshoe magnet attracting two separate small steel nuts through two short teal arcs. Pickup reach.
reinforced-coat
A rugged blue-gray armored coat torso with a broad riveted central steel plate and a small green health plus. Strong distinct torso silhouette.
fast-learner
An open battered field notebook with a single large teal upward chevron emerging from its pages. Experience learning; no letters or numerals.
heavy-rounds
One oversized blunt brass bullet with a heavy steel tip smashing a small jagged impact mark. Broad heavy silhouette, not a thin needle.
long-barrel
A long horizontal scrap-metal gun barrel with a bronze sleeve and one slim pale-blue projectile trail extending to the right. Long-range precision.
split-shot
A central brass projectile splitting into two clearly diverging brass projectiles along a bold Y-shaped orange path.
punch-through
One stout brass projectile passing through two separated steel plates with clean aligned holes and a short orange straight trail.
glass-cannon
A compact translucent cyan glass cannon barrel with one obvious crack and a powerful orange muzzle burst. Fragility plus power.
run-and-gun
One tan feline paw holding a tiny compact scrap pistol angled right, with two teal motion streaks behind the wrist. Movement plus firing.
pistol-deadeye
A recognizable compact scrap pistol with a single pale orange aiming reticle behind its muzzle. Tiny pistol not rifle.
pistol-needle-rounds
A small scrap pistol silhouette above one long slender needle-like brass projectile piercing a single thin steel plate.
smg-overclock
A boxy short SMG receiver and curved magazine under a large orange speed gauge with its needle near maximum. Fast SMG firing.
smg-spray
A boxy SMG silhouette with three slim brass projectiles spraying outward in a broad fan.
shotgun-buckshot
A large red shotgun shell spilling three round lead pellets in a broad fan. Round pellets, no rifle bullets.
shotgun-breacher
A short broad double-barrel shotgun muzzle punching through a cracked riveted steel panel at close range with a compact orange impact burst.
